text:
sam: Heads-up — scheduling a maintenance window for az3 tonight 01:00–03:00 UTC. Thermal firmware patch + NIC hot-swap on affected racks. Plan is rolling reboots at ~10% of GPU pool per cohort. Need ops/oncall coverage and a quick capacity check.

maria: Thanks. Which pools are in-scope? Any Dedicated customers impacted? :eyes:

sam: In-scope: az3-gpu-pool-a, az3-gpu-pool-b (primary), small fraction of az3-gpu-pool-c as fallback. Dedicated customers on pinned hosts should be unaffected but we'll notify accounts on az3.

devon: If we lose two cohorts concurrently, we should backfill from eu-west and us-east burst pools. Cost estimate: ~+18% spot usage for the 2-3 hour window. I can run a quick sim.

leo: On the runbook: we'll do canary -> cohort1 -> cohort2 -> etc. Canary = 3 nodes with stress test + prefix cache warmup. Also plan to warm KV cache to avoid token latency spikes.

jia: Important: runtime needs to fall back to quantized model variant if latency climbs during NIC switch. Confirming auto-fallback policy is enabled for az3 routes?

sam: Yes, fallback policy is enabled for az3 routes. Jia, can you add a quick smoke that calls the quantized variant post-canary?

jia: Will add. Smoke will run: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.local/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-quant-1.0","prompt":"healthcheck"}'` and assert < 300ms tail p95 for 5 requests.

leo: SRE checklist item: pre-drain run: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` (we'll script cohort list). Also will set pool-level concurrency to 60% during the window.

maria: Customer comms: I'll post to the portal and ping sales for any high-touch accounts on az3. Draft message in #customer-success later.

devon: Sim results: we can keep 95% of workloads under SLO by backfilling EU/US, but batch jobs may see queueing. Recommend gating heavy retraining jobs 01:00–05:00 UTC.

sam: Good call. Ops: burnout roster? @ops-bot can you create the calendar invite and pager schedule?

ops-bot: Scheduled: az3 maintenance 1767504321; invite sent to ops-oncall, eng-runtime, eng-sre. Reminder at 45m and 10m.

sam: Post-mortem hooks: if any cohort experiences >10% error increase or p95 latency > 250ms for >15m, abort and rollback. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/az3-hot-swap-runbook
